verdict.rationale: An immigration law firm could reasonably publish how it uses AI in petition drafting and review, so the axis applies. None of the pages in the evidence pack mention AI or automation at all. They describe a dedicated attorney who drafts petitions and says it does not use fill-in-the-blank petitions, but that is a statement about service style, not an AI-use disclosure separating automated work from attorney review.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider states how it uses AI in petition drafting and review — what is automated, what a human attorney checks — on its own pages
